title: Role type (_ai/role-types/<type>/role-type.yaml)
description: The configuration of a kind of role. A role names its type in its role-config.yaml; a prompt run as that role gets the type's tools. Edited in the Role Type Editor (@T: Open Role Type Editor).

name.description: A display name; default the folder's name.

description.description: What kind of role this is.

tools.description: The tools a prompt run as a role of this type gets.

mode.description: profileDefault: the profile's own tool selection, unchanged. selected: exactly the tools listed in `enabled` (they replace the profile's selection), plus the extension's always-on tools.

enabled.description: With mode selected: the tool names (tomAi_*). The always-on tools need not be listed.
